# Recall severity and time targets

Severity follows the hazard type, never the notice's wording.

| Hazard type | Severity |
|---|---|
| microbial | critical |
| allergen | critical |
| electrical_fire | critical |
| choking | critical |
| injury | high |
| chemical | high |
| foreign_matter | high |
| spoilage | medium |
| quality_only | low |

Time targets, counted from the coordinator's approval:

| Severity | Customers messaged within | Shelves clear within |
|---|---|---|
| critical | 30 min | 60 min |
| high | 120 min | 240 min |
| medium | 1440 min | 1440 min |
| low | none | none |

A checkout block is requested for critical recalls; dropping it needs a recorded reason.
A store is exposed when it holds the batch or received it within 30 days; online orders placed within 30 days are messaged.
Exposed stores get a pull for critical, high, medium recalls. For any other severity no store action is proposed: the exposed stores are optional, and the coordinator adds the ones to pull.
